svg.title: SMC clock distribution: u_smc_cpu_wrapper and u_smc_peripherals
svg.desc: Clock distribution inside u_smc_cpu_wrapper and u_smc_peripherals. Six clocks enter on the left: clk_smc_i, clk_ref_i, clk_periph_i, clk_telemetry_i, smc_cpu_jtag_TCK_i and spi_clk_i. clk_smc_i and clk_ref_i run down trunks with one arrow into each of u_smc_cpu_wrapper and u_smc_peripherals. Each box is an RTL instance tinted with the colour of the clock that runs it; a box split into bands runs on several clocks. A clock gate is a tab coloured by the clock it gates, with its instance name in italics, and a dashed arrow runs from the gate to each instance its gated clock reaches. In u_smc_cpu_wrapper, u_refclk_counter in u_smc_cpu_ctrl_wrap counts clk_ref_i into clk_smc_i; in u_smc_cpu, u_debug_clock_gate clocks the debug module through the debug_clock port of u_digital_top, and smc_cpu_jtag_TCK_i clocks the JTAG DTM through debug_systemjtag_jtag_TCK. In u_smc_peripherals, u_smc_peripherals_cdc is drawn as one row per synchroniser or CDC instance, tinted with the source clock on its left half and the destination clock on its right half: the AVSBus, I2C, UART and I3C AXI-Lite CDCs and the clock-gate enable synchronisers cross from clk_smc_i into clk_periph_i, clk_ref_i or clk_telemetry_i; the log-engine AXI-Lite CDC, enable, interrupt and debug synchronisers cross from clk_periph_i into clk_smc_i; u_ndmreset_request_sync synchronises the asynchronous ndmreset_request_i into clk_smc_i. u_i2c_clk_periph_gater clocks u_i2c_wrap, u_uart_clk_periph_gater clocks u_uart_wrap, and u_i3c_clk_periph_gater clocks u_i3ccore_wrapper and leaves the SMC as gated_clk_periph_i3c_o. u_avs_clk_ref_gater drives the clk_ref_i port of u_avsbus_controller, reaching u_gate_refclk_en_sync and u_refclk_clkgate; u_avs_clk_periph_gater drives its clk_reg_i port, reaching u_axi_lite_to_apb, u_avsbus_controller_reg_inst and u_apbclk_clkgate. The two gated clocks meet in the glitch-free mux u_refclk_apbclk_mux; the test mux u_test_clkmux2_0 takes that on clk0_i and the test clock clk_test_i, connected to clk_periph_i, on clk1_i; then the divider u_clk_div and u_avs_bus_clkgate, leaving through u_smc_padring as avs_clock. u_tel_clk_smc_gater and u_tel_clk_telemetry_gater clock the two sides of u_telemetry_receiver_wrap. spi_clk_i passes through u_smc_padring to its pad.
svg.text: Clock gate, coloured by the clock it gates
Synchroniser: source clock left, destination right
